format_rules.decimal_precision_policy: preserve locked values in source tables; round only presentation copies

assets.title: Leakage-Controlled TinyML IDS Experimental Pipeline
assets.scientific_purpose: Summarize data controls, model training, compression, deployment benchmarking, selection, packaging, and robustness.
assets.primary_message: The study is an end-to-end, leakage-aware and deployment-oriented TinyML IDS workflow.

assets.title: Leave-One-Device-Out Generalization
assets.visual_form: device-level grouped point or bar chart
assets.scientific_purpose: Show unseen-device generalization across TinyML-MLP, Compact-DNN, and HGB.
assets.primary_message: Neural TinyML models retain strong performance under strict device holdout.

assets.title: Compression Accuracy and Resource Trade-off
assets.visual_form: Pareto scatter with model size or latency against Macro-F1
assets.scientific_purpose: Compare B0, pruning, DQ, PTQ, QAT, P25-QAT, and P50-QAT.
assets.primary_message: P50-QAT provides a favorable TinyML deployment trade-off.

assets.title: Final Model-Family Pareto Selection
assets.scientific_purpose: Explain why TinyML-MLP P50-QAT was selected under the balanced policy.
assets.primary_message: The final family was chosen from multi-objective deployment evidence, not test-metric ranking of checkpoints.

assets.title: Input Perturbation Robustness
assets.scientific_purpose: Compare TinyML B0, P50-QAT, and HGB under noise, masking, and scale drift.
assets.primary_message: TinyML models are substantially more stable than HGB under noise and scale drift.

assets.title: Dataset, Split, Leakage-Control, and Evaluation Protocol
assets.scientific_purpose: Document sample counts, feature count, class order, split controls, and test-once policy.
assets.primary_message: Evaluation follows locked, leakage-aware and test-isolated protocols.

assets.title: Classical Baseline Performance
assets.scientific_purpose: Report LR, DT, RF, and HGB results.
assets.primary_message: HGB is the strongest clean-data classical baseline but is not the most robust.

assets.title: Five-Seed Compression Results
assets.visual_form: mean, standard deviation, weighted Macro-F1, size, and fragility table
assets.primary_message: QAT preserves accuracy better than post-training dynamic quantization.

assets.title: CPU Deployment Benchmark Results
assets.visual_form: latency, throughput, size, parameter, and MAC comparison table
assets.primary_message: The selected static-INT8 family reduces resource demand while retaining accuracy.

assets.title: Omnibus and Post-hoc Statistical Results
assets.scientific_purpose: Report permutation omnibus results and Holm-adjusted pairwise findings.
assets.primary_message: Global differences are detectable, while five-seed pairwise resolution remains limited.

assets.title: Input Robustness Results
assets.scientific_purpose: Report clean and perturbed performance, FNR, degradation, and fragility.
assets.primary_message: HGB has five severe fragility cases; TinyML models have none.

assets.title: Reproducibility and Release Artifacts
assets.scientific_purpose: Document selected family, canonical checkpoint, artifact representation, release hashes, and lock status.
assets.primary_message: The selected deployment package is independently verified and reproducibly locked.
assets.data_access: external lock and verification files only
